limitations: Graph backend is a local in-memory graph built from the organizer CSVs, not TigerGraph (no TigerGraph instance connected).

Decisions use no LLM: the reasoning is deterministic code over graph query results. After the decision, an LLM (NVIDIA NIM, nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b) writes the case narrative only; the token count is from that step.

Card links: only the flagged transaction (case_pack) and closed-case transactions carry canonical card IDs. The K1/K2/K3 suffix rule is not documented by the organizers (D01), so other transactions attach to the customer only.
Merchant identity (D04) and settlement/authorization status (D05) are not in the data and stay unknown.
Customer replies are simulated with one fixed default (no reply within 24h).
Probability weights are a transparent heuristic, not a trained model.
The case record was written to TigerGraph Savanna (GS_InvestigationCase:HHG-008) and read back, so written_to_graph=true.

narrative.label: LLM-written narrative. Verdict, probability and actions are rule-based; the model only explains them.
